findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: If an attacker can control the startingLocation, they might be able to inject malicious data that leads to unexpected behavior or execution of arbitrary code.
findings.assumptions: The startingLocation is derived from untrusted input, and the mapOfChargingStations is populated with data that could be manipulated by an attacker. The function does not sanitize or validate the startingLocation before using it as a key in the mapOfChargingStations.
